steps.name: 1.1 Retire NEW
steps.acceptance: NO_MATCH cause and no_new policy in verdict.py, shadow_audit and docs updated, listed red tests fixed, stored-NEW receipt replays frozen-equal; changed files 100% lines/branches/functions

steps.name: S0-S3 shared index change
steps.acceptance: suffix constant, end_line and scope fields, read_searchable with every read_symbols caller classified, search_sha, searchable replay snapshot, language and include_tests in the receipt id; private-method receipt replays with differences.frozen == []

steps.name: 1.5 and 1.7 extractor commit
steps.acceptance: TS private/protected members indexed with class named, doc_full, optional contract keys, algorithm_changed fires once; TypeScript tests fail rather than skip when node_modules is absent

steps.name: 1.4 required language parameter
steps.acceptance: check_exists and fetch_similar refuse a missing language with LANGUAGE_REQUIRED and a bad one with LANGUAGE_INVALID before any request; every measurement driver pinned to language all by a test and a census

steps.name: 1.3 Exit gate
steps.acceptance: DISTINCT with no logged search is refused and None fails closed; five new statuses, parse_searched and the RULING_RE edges tested; mutation arms redden named tests

steps.name: 1.2 record_search tool
steps.acceptance: record_search mounted as a fifth reuse tool and greps the same working-tree state its spans come from; unit, mount and stdio tests pass; SKILL.md updated in the same commit; three mutation arms redden named tests

steps.name: 1.6 Tests as a separate scope
steps.acceptance: build and ensure take an optional spec; include_tests=True takes the sweep-only route with its own budget; a default call never reads a test record

steps.name: 1.7 Purpose line, JS roots, dropped entries
steps.acceptance: judge sees doc_full and purpose only when the record has them; script census guard green; dropped entries reported with reasons; cold-sweep call count before and after in the PR

steps.name: 1.8 Index rebuilt during a run
steps.acceptance: probe shows each layer finds a definition written mid-run with a text-derived fake embedder; bound measured on the real tree and committed; INDEX_REFRESH_SLOW tested; isolation test with negative control

steps.name: Phase 1 exit checks
steps.acceptance: full unit tier run last and again at merge, run-census-guards.sh green, coverage gate table shows 100% for every changed file, mutation arms listed in the plan all redden, searchable-entry count before and after in the PR

steps.name: C1 Freeze machinery
steps.acceptance: build_config, freeze and verify_frozen raise CONFIG_DRIFT on any changed field; refreezing raises CONFIG_ALREADY_FROZEN; mutation arms redden

steps.name: C2 Extraction
steps.acceptance: Python and TypeScript bodies, lines and calls extracted; completeness raises EXTRACT_INCOMPLETE; script-file census guard green

steps.name: C3 Blindness
steps.acceptance: scrub and assert_blind raise BLINDNESS_BREACH; identical definitions under two worktree paths give identical prompt bytes

steps.name: C4 Candidates
steps.acceptance: embedding, word and structural lists fused to the top candidates; jscpd added as a pinned dependency; a real jscpd report parsed

steps.name: C5 Judge
steps.acceptance: one call per new definition through model_transport and the Ledger; unreadable replies retried once; resume makes no repeat call

steps.name: C6 Clusters and the score
steps.acceptance: surplus per 100 passing tests matches the hand-worked cases; zero passing tests raises NO_PASSING_TESTS

steps.name: C7 Proof code
steps.acceptance: planted rewrites, monolith pairs, evaluate_bar at exact thresholds and an append-only proof ledger tested with a fake judge

steps.name: C8 Live smoke and throughput
steps.acceptance: 20 real definitions judged through the Max-plan door in the 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Eastern window; seconds per call, failure rate and concurrency recorded

steps.name: Rick approves the frozen prompt and backend
steps.acceptance: Rick has chosen the Max-plan or work-server backend and approved the prompt text, and freeze is committed

steps.name: Rick nominates monolith pairs
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the nominated monolith pairs (source nominated)

steps.name: Rick and the second reviewer label the proof set
steps.acceptance: every planted pair, monolith pair and flag is labelled blind and independently by both people

steps.name: Run the proof
steps.acceptance: proof_run passes 80% found, 80% of flags right and 90% self-agreement, with every run kept in the proof ledger

steps.name: Rick names the passing proof record
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the passing record and the frozen commit used for scoring

steps.name: D1 Schema, quota and the draw
steps.acceptance: quota table sums to 240 ts, 160 py, 300 matched, 100 none; draw raises QUOTA_UNFILLABLE naming the cell

steps.name: Rick finds the second reviewer
steps.acceptance: a second reviewer is named and available for labelling

steps.name: D2 Seeds and key evidence
steps.acceptance: seed pool, stripped need input and key evidence built and tested

steps.name: D3 Drafting
steps.acceptance: needs drafted by Fable after a 10-need live smoke

steps.name: D4 Second model check
steps.acceptance: a second model checks every drafted key and records agreement

steps.name: D5 Labelling tools
steps.acceptance: select_for_labelling, blind packet export with PACKET_LEAK, kappa and dispute tools tested by hand-worked cases

steps.name: Rick approves the source commit and kind split
steps.acceptance: Rick has named the source commit and approved the kind split

steps.name: Rick and the second reviewer label blind
steps.acceptance: both reviewers have labelled every packet item independently

steps.name: Rick breaks the ties
steps.acceptance: every disputed item has Rick's tiebreak recorded

steps.name: D6 Finalize and verify
steps.acceptance: 400 labelled needs committed with keys and verify_manifest passing

steps.name: D7 Statistics
steps.acceptance: kappa and the 95% miss-rate bound computed and tested against hand-worked values

steps.name: D8 Loss tracing
steps.acceptance: loss-report produced from the Phase 1 checker with lost_at counts by kind and language

phases.name: Five scored pairs
phases.expand_trigger: Rick gives the build checkpoint go after Phase 6
